content:
ellie: quick heads-up 80: user on Deno+Bun reports our SDK import fails: Bun resolves ./src/index.ts in the repo and Deno can't find package.json exports when pulling from a CDN.

noah: sounds like our npm publish layout is colliding with ESM-only expectations. Bun's resolver will pick up .ts files in the tarball sometimes. Deno/deno.land wants a single flat mod.ts or explicit URL.

fern: reproducible steps?

ellie: they did `import { Redwood } from 'https://cdn.example.com/redwood@v1.2.0/mod.js'` and got 403 or 404 depending on CDN because exports pointed at `./cjs/` which isn't available in the flattened CDN artifact.

noah: two short fixes: (1) publish a deno artifact (mod.ts + flat esm files) in releases and link to it in README; (2) include a small file `deno/mod.ts` in the package root that re-exports the compiled esm build so CDN consumers have a predictable entry.

ellie: also the SDK retry layer is causing issues in edge runtimes: if body is a ReadableStream or FormData, retry attempts fail because body is consumed. user hit 413/closed body.

fern: we should detect cloneability: if body instanceof FormData || typeof body.getReader === 'function' (and no .tee/clone) then don't retry non-idempotent requests. For small JSON bodies we can buffer.

noah: add client config: `retry: { maxAttempts: 2, bufferBodySize: 8192 }` and default to no-buffer to avoid memory bloat. Document the tradeoffs in the Deno quickstart.

ellie: typing problems: many Deno users see TS errors around AbortSignal, CryptoKey, and globalThis.crypto. Our types reference Node's `crypto.webcrypto` directly.

fern: solution: ship two declaration files `types-deno.d.ts` and `types-node.d.ts` and include a short note in README on `tsconfig.lib` for Deno (add "dom", "webworker", "es2021") so TS picks up WebCrypto types. Also put a `deno.d.ts` in the deno artifact for remote consumers.

noah: runtime helper idea: `utils/runtime-detect.ts` that exposes `getWebCrypto()` and `isCloneableBody(body)` so sample apps can reuse it. Export it from deno/mod.ts.

ellie: CI: add a tiny smoke workflow `.github/workflows/ci-deno-bun.yml` with one matrix job (deno: latest, bun: latest) that runs a single import and a simple request against httpbin. Keep timeouts long enough.

ci-bot: created issue #2731: publish deno artifact + retry guard + types. Assigned to fern/noah/ellie.

olga: one more gotcha: Bun's fetch implements streaming slightly differently and FormData isn't cloneable. Recommend examples show how to send JSON with `new TextEncoder().encode()` for edge jobs.

ellie: thanks. action items: fern -> deno/mod.ts and deno artifact; noah -> retry detection & buffer config; olga -> examples + README section; ellie -> small CI job and PR coordinating. Aim for quick patch this sprint. :shipit:
